run.question:
You are an SRE agent tasked with diagnosing issues in a Kubernetes application.

Application: Social Network
Namespace: social-network

A social network with unidirectional follow relationships, implemented with loosely-coupled microservices, communicating with each other via Thrift RPCs.

CRITICAL: You are running in an AUTOMATED environment. Work autonomously and make all decisions yourself. DO NOT ask for user confirmation or approval. Proceed with the best solution based on your analysis.

TASK: DIAGNOSIS
- Investigate the application to detect any anomalies or issues
- Analyze metrics, logs, and traces
- When ready, submit a natural language description of the issue you found
- Your diagnosis is evaluated on whether you correctly identify the faulty components and root cause

Important:
- You can query metrics and traces through the available observability tools

Pod jaeger-9fd7cdb7c-vl776 is in phase Pending with condition PodScheduled=False, reason Unschedulable, message '0/4 nodes are available: 1 node(s) didn't match pod anti-affinity rules, 1 node(s) had untolerated taint {node-role.kubernetes.io/control-plane: }, 2 node(s) had volume node affinity conflict'.

Events in social-network show the jaeger change and the resulting failures: ReplicaSet jaeger-9fd7cdb7c 'Scaled up ... from 0 to 2' at 17:07:35, pod jaeger-7d8548779-frffw 'Stopping container jaeger' at 17:07:35, PVC jaeger-pvc provisioning events 17:07:34–17:07:38 (ProvisioningSucceeded at 17:07:38), and Warning FailedScheduling x3 on jaeger-9fd7cdb7c-vl776 at 17:07:35–17:07:38 citing unavailable persistent volumes and volume node affinity conflict.

Only the jaeger Deployment is short of its desired replicas: kube_deployment_status_replicas_available minus kube_deployment_spec_replicas equals -1 for deployment jaeger and 0 for all other 26 Deployments in social-network at 2026-11-21T17:07:50Z; the Deployment listing likewise shows jaeger with REPLICAS 2, READY 1, AVAIL 1, UNAVAIL 1.

Prometheus alert rules PendingPodsDetected and PodSchedulingFailure are firing with labels namespace=social-network, pod=jaeger-9fd7cdb7c-vl776 (activeAt 2026-11-21T17:08:09Z), i.e. the only firing alerts are about this Pending/unschedulable jaeger pod.

No container in social-network had restarted by 2026-11-21T17:07:50Z: kube_pod_container_status_restarts_total is 0 for all 28 pods (including the wrk2-job-79cp5 load-generator pod), and the pod listing shows lastState.terminated = null for every app container.

Sampled traces of the write path 17:07:35.897–17:07:40.612Z are successful: /wrk2-api/post/compose spans status http.status_code=200 with 8460–12610 us, compose_post_server 7603–10313 us, and child spans of compose-post-service, text-service, user-mention-service, url-shorten-service, post-storage-service, social-graph-service, home-timeline-service, user-timeline-service, media-service, unique-id-service and user-service all show status not_recorded with no error rows.

Sampled traces of the read path 17:07:43.132–17:07:49.877Z are successful: /wrk2-api/home-timeline/read (1017–2605 us) and /wrk2-api/user-timeline/read (2034–3044 us) spans carry http.status_code=200, with home-timeline-service read_home_timeline_server 474–714 us and user-timeline-service read_user_timeline_server 1182–1617 us.

Transient MongoDB connection errors were logged at startup: user-service 17:07:31.070 and 17:07:32.370 'Error in createIndexes: No suitable servers found: serverSelectionTimeoutMS expired: [unknown connection error calling ismaster on user-mongodb:27017]', with the same pattern for post-storage-service (post-storage-mongodb), url-shorten-service (url-shorten-mongodb) and user-timeline-service (user-timeline-mongodb) at 17:07:28–17:07:32.

user-service retried and then succeeded: after the two 'Failed to create mongodb index, try again' lines it logged '[2026-Nov-21 17:07:33.386326] <info>: (UserService.cpp:94:main) Starting the user-service server ...', and no previous container instance exists for that pod.

social-graph-service emitted a dense stream of '<warning>: (SocialGraphHandler.h:612:GetFollowers) user_id: N not found' lines for many different user ids (e.g. 788, 654, 58, 429, 284) between 2026-11-21T17:07:47.774Z and 17:07:51.691Z.

All four nodes report Ready=True with MemoryPressure, DiskPressure and PIDPressure False; only sregym-control-plane carries the NoSchedule taint node-role.kubernetes.io/control-plane, so three worker nodes are schedulable.

Apart from the jaeger scheduling problem, the social-network Deployments carry no fault-injection style settings: containers run only their normal binaries (e.g. ComposePostService, UserService), no resources requests/limits are set (resources={}), and the only env vars are fqdn_suffix=.social-network.svc.cluster.local on nginx-thrift and media-frontend and COLLECTOR_ZIPKIN_HTTP_PORT=9411 on jaeger.

The Jaeger services named jaeger, jaeger-agent, jaeger-collector and jaeger-query in social-network are type ExternalName pointing at otel-collector.observe.svc.cluster.local (no ports), which is a different entity from the in-namespace jaeger Deployment whose second replica is Pending.

This Prometheus exposes no application trace/RPC metric series: the metric-name listing returned 715 names that are cadvisor, node-exporter, kube-state-metrics, Prometheus, probe and scrape metrics only, with no traces_* or rpc_* application metrics, so service error-rate and latency series for social-network are unavailable here.

The load generator Job wrk2-job was active during the sampled window: kube_job_status_active=1, kube_job_status_failed=0, kube_job_status_succeeded=0 and kube_job_status_start_time=1795280854 (2026-11-21T17:07:34Z) at 2026-11-21T17:07:50Z.

The deepest cause of the observed Pending/unschedulable jaeger replica and of the firing PendingPodsDetected and PodSchedulingFailure alerts is the jaeger Deployment's own configuration: two replicas that must mount one ReadWriteOnce volume and must not co-locate on the same host, on a cluster where the only alternative node is the tainted control plane, leaves exactly one schedulable placement.

The startup 'No suitable servers found / serverSelectionTimeoutMS expired' errors from user-service, post-storage-service, url-shorten-service and user-timeline-service were caused by those application containers connecting before their MongoDB pods were accepting connections (mongo containers started 17:07:28–17:07:31), and were transient rather than an ongoing dependency fault.

The frequent social-graph-service 'GetFollowers user_id not found' warnings suggest that social-graph-mongodb holds no user/follow data in this fresh environment, so home-timeline reads return empty follower lists; whether this is expected before any data seeding and whether it degrades timelines is not established.

Despite the Pending jaeger replica, the application requests visible at 17:07:35–17:07:49 completed successfully (HTTP 200 on compose and both timeline read endpoints, all sub-13 ms), so no user-facing request failure is observed in that sample and the application services cannot be called affected on this evidence.

Service discovery for the dependencies is intact: Endpoints exist with ready addresses and ports for compose-post-service, home-timeline-service, media-service, nginx-thrift, post-storage-service, social-graph-service, text-service, unique-id-service, url-shorten-service, user-mention-service, user-service, user-timeline-service and every MongoDB/Redis/memcached Service, so a missing-endpoint explanation for the observed errors is contradicted.

Rejected: that the jaeger replica is Pending because of node resource pressure or pod crashes/OOM. All nodes report MemoryPressure/DiskPressure/PIDPressure False and Ready True, container restart counts are 0 for every social-network pod, and no container has a terminated last state; the scheduler message names anti-affinity, the control-plane taint and volume constraints instead.

Recommend fixing the jaeger workload's storage/layout: either keep one jaeger replica, or give each replica its own ReadWriteOnce claim (e.g. a StatefulSet with volumeClaimTemplates, or per-replica claims), or drop the required cross-host anti-affinity; then the second replica can bind jaeger-pvc on a schedulable worker instead of staying Pending.

Recommend adding readiness-gated startup for the Thrift services against MongoDB (retry/backoff is already present in the code path) or ordering via init containers, so the observed startup 'No suitable servers found' bursts cannot appear as errors, and consider setting resource requests/limits, which are currently absent on all 27 social-network Deployments.

gaps: Only about 15 seconds of application traffic is observable (traces 17:07:35.897–17:07:49.877Z; logs from 17:07:28Z onward): the whole namespace was deployed at 17:07:26–17:07:35Z, so no pre-deployment behaviour or longer error/latency trend can be examined, and no latency trend is asserted.

Prometheus in this environment has no application trace/RPC metrics: a query for service_name on traces_span_metrics_calls_total returned nothing, and the 715-name metric list contains no traces_* or rpc_* series, so per-service error-rate and latency metrics for social-network are unknown, not zero, even though the alert rules reference traces_span_metrics_calls_total.

The actor and reason for the jaeger Deployment being (re)created at 2026-11-21T17:07:35Z with replicas=2, the PVC and the required anti-affinity are unknown; managedFields were not returned and the change-history integration is not available in this Run.

Log lines between 17:07:33Z and 17:07:52Z matching '<error>|exception|refused|timed out|deadline exceeded' returned nothing and traces matching error=true or status http.status_code=500 returned nothing; these empty results are queries that matched no rows, not proof of absence, so it is unknown whether errors occurred outside the sampled window.

The wrk2-job load-generator Job and its pod disappeared from the API before 17:08Z (no jobs or wrk2 pods listed at 17:09–17:10Z although kube-state-metrics showed wrk2-job active at 17:07:50Z), so its final result and any request failures it recorded are unknown.

Whether social-graph-mongodb (and the other MongoDB instances) contain seeded data is unverified: MongoDB data was not read, and the social-graph 'GetFollowers user_id not found' warnings are therefore unexplained between expected-empty fresh state and a data problem.
Secrets (e.g. the 'secret' field of service-config.json, TLS keys) cannot be read, so no conclusion depends on those values and they were not verified.

The traces view is a biased sample from a single Jaeger instance started 17:07:39Z (the second replica never scheduled); spans omitted from the sample and requests outside it are unknown, and no complete call chain is claimed.
next_steps: Patch or re-render the jaeger Deployment so the second replica is schedulable (single replica, or per-replica RWO claims via StatefulSet, or relaxed anti-affinity) and confirm jaeger reaches 2/2 ready and both PendingPodsDetected and PodSchedulingFailure clear.

Re-run the load test for several minutes and re-check the trace/log error signals (per-service HTTP 5xx, error spans, 'No suitable servers found') to determine whether any user-facing symptom exists that the current 15-second sample cannot show.

Inspect the MongoDB instances for user/follow data and, if the environment expects seeded users, verify or run the data seeding step for social-graph-mongodb before judging the GetFollowers not-found warnings.

Add application trace metrics (traces_span_metrics_calls_total / traces_span_metrics_duration_milliseconds_bucket) scraping for the social-network namespace, since the alert rules that reference them currently have no data in this Prometheus.
